positions.title: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Program by E&ICT Academy, Artificial Intelligence
description: Currently pursuing the Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Program offered by Masai School in collaboration with E&ICT Academy, IIT Roorkee.
The program focuses on Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Python programming, data analytics, and real-world problem solving through project-based learning.
Curriculum includes industry-oriented training, hands-on implementation, teamwork, and application-driven learning through multiple modules and capsule projects.
